title: William Barclay Harding Professor of Business Administration Chair, General Management Program
bio: Test more, assume less. Learn how to adopt a scientific mindset. Every day, leaders face high-stakes decisions about products, customers and strategy. Beyond the workplace, people make countless choices about their health, behavior, and the information they trust. Yet too many of these decisions rely on untested assumptions. Overconfidence, gut instinct, and “what worked before” often substitute for evidence, leaving people and organizations exposed to costly missteps. How can leaders navigate today’s uncertainty and complexity and make smarter choices? In The Scientific Mindset: How Thinking Scientifically Drives Better Business Decisions Harvard Business School professor and innovation expert Stefan Thomke offers a compelling solution: adopt a scientific mindset. Drawing on decades of research and real-world examples, Thomke shows how challenging assumptions, articulating testable hypotheses, and running disciplined experiments transform decision-making. This concise, practical guide introduces a new leadership model grounded in evidence, not just intuition. Through vivid stories—from famous science experiments to companies like Amazon and Lego reinventing themselves—Thomke demonstrates how thinking scientifically uncovers hidden truths, mitigates risk, and inspires innovation. Readers will learn how to ask deeper questions, design trustworthy experiments, build cultures that value curiosity over certainty, and develop AI-systems that ensure reliability while scaling testing. Along the way, Thomke reveals why intellectual humility and a willingness to be proven wrong are hallmarks of great leadership. Adopting a scientific mindset isn’t just smart—it’s essential for leading effectively today. Whether you’re launching a product, rethinking strategy, or making sense of a rapidly changing world, The Scientific Mindset is your roadmap for making better decisions.
